notes.notes:
Q.Why does it end with Episode 1?

A.
The game was originally released on other sites such as Dlsite under the title "Under the Witch: Beginnings" and was rejected by Steam. It was once rejected by Steam, so we changed the name to Hero's journey.

Under the Witch: Beginnings will only include episodes 0 & 1. Therefore, no more episodes will be added to this game.

And the one currently in development is called "Under the Witch: Gothic," which is EPISODE 2.
EPISODE 2 contains about 10 witches and is a larger game than "Under the Witch: Beginnings. It is in effect "Hero's Jounrey 2. However, I don't know if the content will allow for a Steam release.

To summarize, Under the Witch is

”Beginnings(Hero's Journey)"：Episode0＆1
"Gothic(Hero's Jouney2)" :Episode2
"？？？" : Episode3
”？？？” : Episode4
"？？？"：Episode5
"？？？"：Episode6

These releases will be divided into each episodes

notes.notes:
[b]Q.  How to fix"Fatal error: [File:Unknown] [Line: 729]BulkData compressed header read error. This package may be corrupt!"[/b]

A.You can fix by deleting LocalProfile.sav

It's here
C:\Users\”UserName”\AppData\Local\HerosJourney\Saved\Savegames



[b]Q. How to fix ‘Unreal Engine is exiting due to D3D device being lost’?[/b]

A.You should update graphic driver

Please search with words such as "D3D error UE4" as there may be other causes


[b]Q.Are there any additional episodes?[/b]

No, I do not.
This is a finished game, not Early Access.
I am working on my next game, but that will not be part of this game update.
